license: Apache-2.0 (free for personal and commercial use)

resources.audioSecondsTypical: ~15-45 seconds per clip on consumer GPU (100 steps DPM++ 3M-SDE)

notes: The full Stable Audio Open release — ~1.21B parameters, supports clips up to 47 seconds, 100 diffusion steps with DPM++ 3M-SDE by default for higher quality. Apache 2.0 — commercial use unrestricted. The right pick when audio quality matters more than latency (background music, podcast bumpers, ambient soundtracks, foley for video). For real-time SFX in voice agents, use stable-audio-open-small instead.
